newsitem.title: UK: Fluor down in London after losses warning.
newsitem.headline: Fluor down in London after losses warning.

text.p: Shares in Fluor Corp were down $4 or seven percent to $52 in Europe on Wednesday, after the company warned of losses for the next quarter.

After Wall Street closed on Tuesday, the engineering, construction and diversified services company, whose shares have dropped by around 30 percent since mid-February, said it expected to report a second quarter loss of about $70 million, or $0.83 a share.
"It's more bad news from a company that has had its share of bad news over the past couple of months," one dealer said.
On February 18, the shares hit an all-time closing high of $75 but analysts downgrades followed disappointing first quarter earnings, reported on February 20.
On March 14 alone, downgrades by Dean Witter, Oppenheimer & Co and Smith Barney helped push Fluor shares down over $6 or 10 percent as analysts cited lack of confidence in the company's focus.
